sources.title: t5-large: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview t5-large is a 770 million parameter encoder-decoder transformer developed by google-t5 that treats all NLP tasks as text-to-text problems. Unlike BERT-style models that output class labels or input spans, T5 converts every language task into a unified format where both inputs and outputs are text strings, allowing a single model, loss function, and hyperparameter set to work across ...

sources.title: T5 (language model) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: T5 (Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer) is a series of large language models developed by Google AI introduced in 2019. [1][2] Like the original Transformer model, [3] T5 models are encoder-decoder Transformers, where the encoder processes the input text, and the decoder generates the output text.
